title: SIDESTORY: UNREALIZED REALITIES OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Unrealized Realities event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Maintenance Checklist] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Skybox], Airborne Living Capsule Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Dr Oxygen, etc.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Dr Oxygen by clearing event stages and completing [Maintenance Checklist]. Dr Oxygen can be used to redeem items from [Stratosphere Estate Agency].

REWARDS: Skybox's Token, Airborne Living Capsule Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, EPOQUE Collection - Eggcellent Craftsman for Greyy, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – 600 METERS OVER THE FACTS
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [600 Meters Over the Facts], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game:

- Operator Skybox is currently ONLY available from the Unrealized Realities event, and is NOT available in [600 Meters Over the Facts] headhunting or any [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting].
- Nasti and Cairn will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after June 4, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Nasti, Cairn, and Skybox will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 ICEFIELD MESSENGER COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Icefield Messenger Collection - Glowing Flame in the Night for Reed the Flame Shadow
Icefield Messenger Collection - A Pure Pianissimo for Fang the Fire-Sharpened
05 RE-EDITION OUTFITS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Shining Steps Collection - Dreaming High for Ray
Shining Steps Collection - Top Tier Live for Tequila
EPOQUE Collection - Amidst the Pieces for Puzzle
06 NEW FURNITURE SET – AIRBORNE LIVING CAPSULE
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, Airborne Living Capsule will be available.
- Unrealized Realities event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Supporter Dualchip * 4, Supporter Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 19, Top Operator Training Apparatus * 1
Top Operator Training Apparatus: Use to level up a 6-star Operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 90. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 12, Top Operator Skill Training Pack *1, Senior Operator Skill Training Pack * 1,
Top Operator Skill Training Pack: You can select a 6-star Operator that meets the requirements and level a skill to Specialization Level 3.
08 NEW REDEEMABLE AVAILABLE IN [DISTINCTIONS] AND [UNIVERSAL CERTIFICATES EXCHANGE AREA]
DETAILS: New redeemable in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area]:
Icefield Messenger Collection - Cheerful Guardian for Cardigan
Please stay tuned for more information!
